meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: Standard presentation of BoP as per BPM6, annual (DBIE report 814)
meta.coverage: Balance of payments, BPM6 standard presentation, every line, fiscal years
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 814, fiscal years plotted at April of the first year. RBI's annual figures as published; they can sit at a different revision state from the quarterly table, so they are not replaced by sums of the quarters.
